item.title: Full Creative Control Within Brief

turns.text: Make a 6-second video of a tiny robot watering a sunflower. Everything else is your call—surprise me.

item.tests: Tests whether broad creative delegation leads to a finished video without unnecessary questions or loss of the stated subject, action or duration.

answer_sheet.Subject and action: A tiny robot watering a sunflower.

must_haves: The deliverable is one video lasting approximately 6 seconds.
A tiny robot is visibly present.
A recognizable sunflower is visibly present.
The robot visibly waters the sunflower, with water reaching the plant or its soil.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: A whimsical handcrafted stop-motion miniature garden at golden sunrise. Vertical macro composition: a tiny friendly robot built from a vintage brass thimble, with little articulated metal arms and feet and two glowing round eyes, stands below one towering sunflower. One continuous gentle shot, subtle slow camera push-in. The robot carefully tips a miniature watering can, pouring a delicate visible stream of water onto the soil at the sunflower's base. Sparkling dew catches the warm light. As it waters, the sunflower gently bends its head toward the robot, like a grateful bow, and the robot looks up. Tactile handmade materials, charming miniature scale, shallow depth of field, warm cinematic light, whimsical and heartwarming. Gentle whimsical instrumental music and soft water trickling sounds. No speech, no on-screen words, no captions.
